purpose: Define the upstream pointwise support producer independently of EOG reachability and independently of held-out benchmark outcomes.

relationship_to_eog.support_model_estimand: pointwise fitted occurrence support at each model-evaluable island
relationship_to_eog.eog_role: downstream structural transformation / reachability analysis of the frozen support and training-presence anchors
relationship_to_eog.not_a_claim: This contract does not assert that EOG is a superior SDM, and the SDM is not tuned to make EOG look favorable.

island_units.missing_coordinate_policy: Primary model excludes any island lacking a finite frozen centroid and retains it in an applicability audit. No coordinate imputation is allowed after outcomes are inspected.
island_units.reason_area_archipelago_unused: The exact downloadable version-1.0 tables audited before model outcomes do not contain the paper-described Area or Arch_lvl_1/Arch_lvl_2 attributes.

variables.role: maximum near-surface air temperature of the warmest month
minimum near-surface air temperature of the coldest month

climate_source.variable_selection_rule: Five generic climate axes were frozen before SDM/EOG outcomes: annual temperature, warm and cold temperature extremes, annual precipitation, and precipitation seasonality. No variable screening, stepwise selection, univariate filtering, PCA choice, or importance-based removal is allowed from benchmark outcomes.
climate_source.extraction_rule: Sample each frozen island centroid directly from each CHELSA raster. An island with any missing or non-finite primary climate value is support-model-ineligible for the primary analysis; do not search for a nearby finite cell or change the coordinate after outcomes are seen.
climate_source.future_sensitivity_only: A separately labelled nearest-finite-cell extraction may be evaluated only as a sensitivity analysis after the primary direct-centroid result is frozen and may not replace it.

pointwise_support_model.implementation: deterministic benchmark implementation; one model per species and fold
pointwise_support_model.response: island-level presence/absence from comprehensive A-Islands flora incidence
pointwise_support_model.standardization: z-score each predictor using training islands only within each fold; apply the training mean and standard deviation to held-out islands
pointwise_support_model.constant_predictor_policy: If a predictor has zero or non-finite training standard deviation, the species-fold SDM is marked failed; predictors are not silently dropped.
pointwise_support_model.insufficient_training_policy: mark the species-fold SDM as not evaluable; do not change the holdout, substitute a model, or borrow held-out labels
pointwise_support_model.prediction: logistic fitted support in [0,1] for all climate-evaluable islands
pointwise_support_model.interpretation: relative fitted occurrence support for ranking/conditioning; not assumed to be calibrated occupancy probability

evaluation_partition.block_origin: global lon/lat origin used by floor((lon+180)/5), floor((lat+90)/5)
evaluation_partition.assignment: unique blocks sorted by descending island count then block ID; greedily assigned to the currently smallest fold with ties to the lower fold ID
evaluation_partition.interpretation: evaluation partition only; these blocks are not ecological barriers, dispersal kernels, colonisation units, or connectivity estimates

leakage_boundary.held_out_labels: not available to model fitting, standardization, EOG anchoring, graph tuning, threshold choice, or scenario selection
allowed_information_on_held_out_nodes_be: predeclared graph geometry when later frozen
forbidden: using held-out presences as EOG anchors
choosing EOG graph thresholds from held-out results

failure_reporting.primary_structural_comparison_denominato: predeclared later in the reachability contract; this model contract does not choose an EOG-favorable denominator

next_freeze: Freeze the island reachability graph/scenario family and the held-out conditional comparison separately after this support contract is merged, but before any EOG reachability outcome is inspected.
